title: Evolving Pinterest's Embedding Retrieval Platform
summary: Frees Manas from HNSW's need to hold whole indexes in RAM by quantizing vectors and serving SPANN from SSD.

title: Achieving Near-Linear Training Scalability for Pinterest’s Foundation Models
summary: Fixes poor multi-node scaling from cross-node embedding all-to-all with 2D parallelism that keeps it in each node.

title: Next-Level Personalization: How 16k+ Lifelong User Actions Supercharge Pinterest’s Recommendations
summary: Extends ranking past recent actions with TransActV2, selecting each candidate's nearest lifelong actions on GPU.

title: Change Data Capture at Pinterest
summary: Fits single-shard Debezium to sharded databases without a fork by reconciling per-shard connectors to ZooKeeper.

title: Structured DataStore (SDS): Multi-model Data Management With a Unified Serving Stack
summary: Merges services that each rebuilt caching and routing into SDS, where every API compiles to a Thrift query language.

title: Redesigning Pinterest’s Ad Serving Systems with Zero Downtime (part 2)
summary: Rebuilds Mohawk, whose mutable Thrift data invited races, as AdMixer with a typed DAG and a write-once data model.

title: TiDB Adoption at Pinterest
summary: Breaks a benchmark tie among NewSQL stores to replace HBase by shadowing Ixia traffic, which only TiDB sustained.

title: Building Pinterest’s new wide column database using RocksDB
summary: Builds Rockstorewidecolumn to move UserMetaStore off HBase by keying RocksDB on row, column and timestamp.

title: Online Data Migration from HBase to TiDB with Zero Downtime
summary: Repairs drift in a live HBase-to-TiDB move, as failed dual writes never roll back, with repeated MapReduce diffs.

title: Improving Distributed Caching Performance and Efficiency at Pinterest
summary: Cuts memcached tail latency spikes from scheduler waits behind other host processes by running it under SCHED_FIFO.

title: 99% to 99.9% SLO: High Performance Kubernetes Control Plane at Pinterest
summary: Ends head-of-line blocking in controller workqueues by delaying informer-init Creates and resync Updates.

title: MemQ: An efficient, scalable cloud native PubSub system
summary: Avoids Kafka's costly rebalancing and replication for latency-tolerant data with MemQ, which batches writes to S3.

title: How we scaled the size of Pinterest’s ad corpus by 60x
summary: Moves the ads index, which outgrew funnel memory, to a KV store read in parallel with ranking to hide the RPC.

title: Using Kafka to throttle QPS on MySQL shards in bulk write APIs
summary: Shifts bulk writes off APIs whose rate limits let hot MySQL shards through onto a paced Kafka partition per shard.

title: Sharding Pinterest: How we scaled our MySQL fleet
summary: Swaps crashing NoSQL stores for MySQL shards that are named in every object ID and move between hosts whole.

title: Serving configuration data at scale with high availability
summary: Stops fleetwide reloads from saturating one Redis master by putting config in S3 and its version in ZooKeeper.
